allocation_bytes.source: Schema-2 lookup-only JFR observed zero matching allocation-event bytes for 20x Hybrid; zero-event PASS is explicit, enumeration/publication are excluded, and this benchmark/full-report policy remains authoritative.

client_index_ms.source: Schema-2 actual compact Hybrid dedicated-client index p95 is 1.0574 ms at 1x and 32.2413 ms at 20x; the online side-aware metric is gated against the predeclared 3 s hard boundary.

client_reload_ms.source: Schema-2 actual compact Hybrid dedicated-client reload p95 is 1.872 ms at 1x and 53.864 ms at 20x; the online side-aware metric is gated against this envelope.

datapack_authored_entries.source: T46 forward-v2 keeps 6000/6600 as historical comparison references. datapack_authored_entries is REPORT_ONLY and does not raise BudgetExceededError or participate in winner / failed_gates.

eager_publication_rows.source: T14 Hybrid closes at 16650 eager rows; 18000 soft and the existing 21000 hard ceiling retain measured margin.

lazy_cache_ceiling_rows.source: Selected Hybrid uses a measured per-epoch 512-row cache ceiling; 1024/4096 are soft/hard aggregate family envelopes.

lazy_logical_rows.source: T14 compact Hybrid has 2225 live lazy rows; actual-distribution 20x measured 55640 total relations.

lookup_candidate_count.source: Across all three schema-2 Hybrid traces, lookup candidates are p50<=8, p95<=8, max=8; the production p95/max candidate metric is wired to the 64/128 gates.

lookup_p95_ns.source: Schema-2 maximum-trace Hybrid lookup p95 is 1543 ns at 1x and 2950 ns at 20x; the production lookup p95 metric is wired to the existing 1 ms soft and 2 ms hard gates.

retained_memory_bytes.source: Schema-2 lookup-only controlled-GC jcmd histogram retained 21934784 bytes for 20x Hybrid; enumeration was not executed and 128/512 MiB remain the authoritative benchmark/full-report envelopes.

server_index_ms.source: Production GameTest index is 112 ms after complete family validation; 500 ms soft and the existing 1 s hard ceiling are confirmed.

server_reload_ms.source: Production GameTest reload with complete transient family validation is 9486 ms; this exceeds the 5 s soft warning but remains under the existing 10 s hard ceiling.

sync_bytes.source: Schema-2 actual compact Hybrid sync is 331124 bytes at 1x and 9877420 bytes at 20x; the production compact-payload metric is wired to the predeclared 64 MiB hard gate.

note: Forward-v2 load budget policy. Other axes inherit v1 hard gates. Authored entries stay counted but are report-only.

scope.contract: Per-family explicit authored, logical, eager, lazy, cache, sync and measured interval ledger.
scope.hard_ceiling_behavior: Projection fails closed when a non-authored interval or scalar exceeds a hard ceiling. datapack_authored_entries overage is reported.
scope.legacy_limits_retained_until: T14c production strategy measurements replace or explicitly confirm them.
scope.pending_behavior: Unmeasured dimensions remain BLOCKED_PENDING_MEASUREMENT and are never assigned guessed values.
scope.soft_budget_behavior: Projection remains inspectable with SOFT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED when below the hard ceiling.
